title: 序章 BOSS · 终焉使者（重建规则）
notice: 这是基于 APK 静态证据制作的重建规则演示，并非原服务器或原版完整战斗。队伍、卡组归属、卡牌系数、状态目标枚举、BOSS 技能和行为树顺序来自源表；目标类型 9 按枚举名 FIRST_MID_LAST 解释为编队优先级、增益 1001 按描述索引 %s*6 折算攻击因子、阵亡角色卡牌移出牌堆、抽牌能量与手牌上限均为重建政策。原解析器代码未恢复。

playerFactor.source: card.RPG_DEFAULT_FORMULA[0][0] (same as first-encounter-reconstruction-v1); state-row factors that differ are recorded as conflicts

targetEnums.16: ENUM_SINGEL: camp 0 -> the boss; camp 1 -> the card owner
targetEnums.17: ENUM_ALL: camp 1 -> every living party member
targetEnums.9: ENUM_OPPOSITE_FIRST_MID_LAST: first living member in formation order, re-selected per hit

attackBuff.mapping: one attack factor 1 + stacks*6/100.0 passed through attackFactorValue; permanent for the battle

drawValue.source: card SKILL_DIY_VALUE[VALUE] when present (410102 -> 0, same override as the first encounter), else state STORYLINE_PARAM.VALUE

memberDefeat.rule: a defeated member's cards move to the removed pile; the party loses when every member is defeated

enemyTurns.source: bt/xinshou_zhongyanshizhe.xml selector: round 1 -> 74503, round 2 -> 74501, odd -> 74502, even -> 74503

specialSkill.note: This deck has no ultimate card; per-character ultimates are not part of this reconstruction.
